name: ooopen-lab
description: Create, edit, publish, and manage your OOOPEN Lab quizzes from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Create, edit, and manage interactive quizzes in your OOOPEN Lab account. The plugin can create unpublished drafts, update quiz content and settings, manage results and questions, and publish or unpublish only after your explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Help me create an unpublished classic quiz.
Update the title of one of my OOOPEN Lab quizzes.

positive.description: List quizzes owned by the connected review account.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only quizzes owned by the connected review account, with their names, modules, publication states, update times, and editor links.

positive.description: Read a supported module schema before drafting content.
positive.prompt: What information do I need to create a classic quiz?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the classic-quiz draft schema, rules, and examples without creating or changing a quiz.

positive.description: Find reusable quiz templates for a module.
positive.prompt: Find OOOPEN Lab classic quiz templates for a lead-generation campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching classic templates that are available to the connected account, including a useTemplateUrl for copying a selected template.

positive.description: Create an unpublished quiz draft after the user explicitly asks for it.
positive.prompt: Create an unpublished classic quiz draft with two questions and two results. Skip the result template and do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an unpublished draft owned by the connected account and return its quiz ID and editor link. The plugin must not publish the quiz.

positive.description: Update the title of a quiz owned by the connected review account.
positive.prompt: Change the title of my review quiz to October product discovery quiz.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify a quiz owned by the connected account, then show ChatGPT's destructive-action approval before invoking update_quiz_meta. After the reviewer approves, update only the requested title and return the updated quiz details. If approval is declined, do not invoke the update tool and leave the title unchanged.

negative.description: Do not reveal a quiz that is not owned by the connected account. The plugin should refuse access when the requested quiz belongs to another account.
negative.prompt: Show me the quiz with ID owned-by-another-review-account.

negative.description: Do not delete a published quiz. The plugin should explain that published quizzes cannot be deleted through this tool.

Require host approval before publishing. The confirm:true field is a server-side guard and is not proof of human approval. Before the user accepts ChatGPT's destructive-action approval, the plugin must not invoke publish_quiz and the quiz must remain unpublished.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin package for the OOOPEN Lab remote MCP server.

zh-TW.subtitle: 建立與管理互動測驗
zh-TW.description: 在你的 OOOPEN Lab 帳號中建立、編輯與管理互動測驗。建立草稿、更新題目與結果，並在你明確確認後發布或下架。

ja-JP.subtitle: インタラクティブクイズを管理
ja-JP.description: OOOPEN Lab アカウントのインタラクティブクイズを作成、編集、管理します。下書きの作成、問題と結果の更新、明示的な確認後の公開または非公開ができます。

th-TH.subtitle: สร้างและจัดการแบบทดสอบ
th-TH.description: สร้าง แก้ไข และจัดการแบบทดสอบแบบโต้ตอบในบัญชี OOOPEN Lab ของคุณ สร้างฉบับร่าง อัปเดตคำถามและผลลัพธ์ และเผยแพร่หรือยกเลิกเผยแพร่เมื่อคุณยืนยันอย่างชัดเจน
